claims.quote: A whole market is too big to predict and one customer is too noisy.
Studio models the groups in between, and the influence running between them, because groups behave in patterns you can trust.
A streaming service tests 5 cancellation flows and finds the pause offer keeps 3 times more subscribers.
A retail bank introduces a monthly account fee 3 ways and finds the one customers accept without leaving.
The same decision in the same society returns the same result.
